header.text: Connecting a claim to evidence that supports the claim

contents.text: Those who learn how to deal with setbacks when they are young often succeed later in life. Consider, for example, founding father Benjamin Franklin, who had to leave school at age ten due to a lack of money but continued learning on his own and became one of the most celebrated writers of his age.
Other transitions that show this type of relationship include for instance, to illustrate, and for example.

header.text: Connecting two pieces of supporting evidence

contents.text: Delaying the start of the school day to allow students to sleep later has a number of benefits. Later start times are associated with higher scores on math and reading tests, especially in disadvantaged populations. Additionally, a number of studies indicate that students whose schools switch to later start times experience lower rates of driving accidents and substance abuse.
Other transitions that show this type of relationship include furthermore, likewise, moreover, and in a similar vein.

contents.text: Those who learn how to deal with setbacks when they are young often succeed later in life. Consider, for example, founding father Benjamin Franklin, who had to leave school at age ten due to a lack of money but continued learning on his own and became one of the most celebrated writers of his age.
Other transitions that show this type of relationship include for instance, to illustrate, and for example.

header.text: Connecting two pieces of supporting evidence

contents.text: Delaying the start of the school day to allow students to sleep later has a number of benefits. Later start times are associated with higher scores on math and reading tests, especially in disadvantaged populations. Additionally, a number of studies indicate that students whose schools switch to later start times experience lower rates of driving accidents and substance abuse.
Other transitions that show this type of relationship include furthermore, likewise, moreover, and in a similar vein.

header.text: Connecting supporting evidence to analysis of that evidence

contents.text: In our information-saturated world, people are losing the ability to sustain focus for extended periods of time. Blog posts of today are shorter, on average, than they were ten to fifteen years ago. Evidently, people are less willing than they once were to read long chunks of text.
Other transitions that show this type of relationship include in other words, apparently, and to put it differently.

header.text: Connecting a claim to a counterclaim

contents.text: Doctors should be more cautious about ordering expensive tests and procedures that may be unnecessary. Of course, some will say that it is better to be over-vigilant when it comes to health. In fact, though, unnecessary medical procedures can actually cause harm to patients.
Other transitions that show this type of relationship include admittedly, to be sure, I'll admit that, and granted.

header.text: Connecting a counterclaim to a response to that counterclaim

contents.text: Naysayers may point out that locally owned businesses cannot offer the steep discounts that large online retailers can. That being said, consumers should remember that small businesses contribute to their local economy by providing jobs and paying taxes.
Other transitions that show this type of relationship include on the contrary, at the same time, actually, and yet.
